ci-alert-bot: perf-alert nightly-infer-ci: p95 generation latency +28% vs baseline for nightly-image-gen-quant. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/alerts/6240012345 :rotating_light:
alex: saw the alert, grabbing logs. which bench was running?
maya: nightly-image-gen-quant — we kicked off q4 quant variant in the nightly matrix at 00:10 UTC.
alex: could be quant + serving change interaction. @jiwon can you check recent kernel/scheduler rollouts?
jiwon: I didn't touch model kernels. I did flip the scheduler 'yield-window' tweak in canary around 12:30 UTC. tagging @riley to check autoscaler side.
riley: I rolled back the autoscaler scale-down tweak at ~02:00 UTC earlier, but I'll pull traces now. can someone post a failing sample req id?
sam: sample id from failing run: req_20260314_9812 — trace: https://dash.redwood.ai/trace/req_20260314_9812 :eyes:
alex: thanks. can we repro with micro-bench using --dynamic-batcher=false? /cc @maya
maya: starting a small fleet run, will post numbers in ~10m. command I'm running: ./bench_runner --model=hf/my-model --seq=512 --iters=200 --quant=q4_0 --dynamic-batcher=false
jiwon: quick note — nodes on driver 525 show slight uptick in context switches today vs baseline, I'll correlate with sample nodes.
riley: infra logs show KV cache hit rate dropped 72% -> 40% during the spike window. looks like eviction pressure when batch composition changed.
alex: ok this points to cache + batcher interaction. @sam can you capture perf counters on the sample host? suggested: sudo perf record -F 99 -g -- ./serve --model hf/my-model --seq 512
sam: capturing now; also pulling /proc/interrupts and tail of dmesg to S3. will attach links once uploaded.
ci-alert-bot: update: nightly run finished; p95 delta now +15% after autoscaler rollback. monitoring continues.
maya: local micro-bench finished — p95 +2% when dynamic-batcher=false. so batcher feature likely the main contributor.
jiwon: propose rolling back batcher-change flag on canary and hold until we fix eviction interaction. who can flip the flag?
riley: I can flip the flag on canary in ~15m and watch telemetry. I'll leave a short note in the canary release log.
alex: good plan. also please open a perf regression ticket with repro steps and sample IDs, I'll add it to the regression suite and assign to maya/jiwon.
maya: created ticket INF-4219 with repro steps, sample ids, and bench command: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4219
sam: :thumbsup:
